lessons.subtitle: VOWEL SOUNDS (SHORT & LONG)
lessons.introText: Vowels (a, e, i, o, u) have two main sounds. Short vowels are quick and clipped: a as in cat, e as in pen, i as in sit, o as in pot, u as in sun. Long vowels say their own name: a as in cake, e as in bee, i as in bike, o as in cone, u as in cube. A silent e at the end (like cake, bike, cone) usually makes the vowel long. In closed syllables (like cat, sit), the vowel stays short. Listen and compare the pairs below.
